scope: Published text/lemma/morphology references. No original source image rights, no independent blind expert-gold.

aed.publisher: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae / Ancient Egyptian Dictionary; conversion by Simon D. Schweitzer
aed.extraction: Per <entry xml:id> preserve first <orth>, first <gramGrp><term>, optional root xref and English sense quote; decode XML character entities; no lemma/root inference.

aes.publisher: Ancient Egyptian Sentences / TLA-AED; JSON conversion by Simon D. Schweitzer
aes.coverage_scope: Felsinschriften subcorpus; scholarly transcription and labels, not corresponding manuscript image pixels.

attribution: Cite scholarly TLA/AED 2018 contributors and Simon D. Schweitzer; modifications are structured extract and held-out testing, data remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
holdout_policy: No annotations from target AES text ID may contribute to its observed-token exact-form lookup; AED dictionary is independently published shared reference and may overlap historically with AES source. Treat metrics as diagnostic, not independent linguistic model generalization.
notes: Cross-text source IDs may still share publications/editions/pretraining. No claim of a sealed blind test, image-conditioned reading or model calibration.
